title: Call a symbolic recording with symbolic arguments: its expressions with the arguments substituted
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG12.60 (maintainer 2026-10-26): a recording evaluated with exudyn.symbolic arguments returns a copy of its expressions in which its argument variables are replaced by the given expressions, as Optimize copies nodes; for one expression per kind of the symbolic system (the residual M q_tt - f), for the forces of connectors composed with the marker kinematics of the bodies, and for the export of one program per kind (RG12.51.5).
